semiconductor_relevance: High — Intlvac Thin Film specializes in advanced vacuum deposition and nanofabrication solutions that are critical for semiconductor device fabrication.
summary: Intlvac Thin Film is a leader in advanced vacuum deposition and nanofabrication solutions, providing systems for precision nanostructuring and robust pattern transfer. Their Icarus Indium Bump Deposition system is designed for high-volume applications in microelectronics and photonics, enabling defect-free interconnects and optimized throughput.
capabilities: Icarus Indium Bump Deposition system for microelectronics and optoelectronics
Turnkey lab solutions for Lithium Niobate device fabrication
Advanced vacuum deposition systems for photonics and quantum technologies
